actions.failure_mode: A release could produce a false 100% behavior-test denominator from an unlocked corpus.
actions.problem: V15 announces typedb-behaviour as mandatory but §1.1 lists only TypeDB, SlateDB and an optional Containers repo.
actions.required_change: Add BH to the lock and make missing BH a G0 failure.
actions.title: Normative source lock contradicts the document

actions.failure_mode: Cargo/Bazel parity, fixtures and package layout cannot be reproduced from TB/SL/BH alone.
actions.problem: The selected MODULE.bazel also pins typedb/dependencies, bazel-distribution, TypeQL, typedb-protocol, Console/Loader artifacts, Rust 1.93.0 and base images.
actions.required_change: Lock the whole proof-critical graph; resolve tags/artifacts/images to immutable digests.
actions.title: TypeDB external proof graph is incomplete

actions.failure_mode: Cross references and evidence counts are ambiguous; automated document validation can pass the wrong appendix.
actions.problem: V15 contains two Appendix F sections. The second says 11/11 anchors but visibly enumerates six numbered items.
actions.required_change: Assign unique appendix IDs and make evidence counts machine-generated.
actions.title: Two appendices have the same identity

actions.failure_mode: Cargo feature unification, profiles, lock resolution, paths and rebase behavior may change before any storage patch.
actions.problem: V15 makes moonrepo the task authority and flattens 41 TypeDB members plus SlateDB and tooling into one root Cargo workspace.
actions.required_change: Keep federated upstream-shaped workspaces. Treat any task runner as replaceable orchestration.
actions.title: The monorepo proposal creates a new semantic build system

actions.failure_mode: The audit mode cannot be reproduced or governed because its own policy is self-contradictory.
actions.problem: V15 says Bazel is never executed anywhere, then requires a sacrificial cquery snapshot.
actions.required_change: Choose explicit Mode Q (isolated query oracle) or Mode S (static expansion), never both rhetorically.
actions.title: Zero-Bazel language contradicts the one-time cquery plan

actions.failure_mode: An autonomous agent can land semantic changes in the wrong phase and claim the wrong gate.
actions.problem: V15 P2/P3/P4 labels do not match the §23 TB-P/SL-P responsibilities consistently.
actions.required_change: Use one stable patch registry and map each phase to exact IDs.
actions.title: The playbook references patch numbers inconsistently

actions.failure_mode: A helper reset, lifecycle alarm, rollout or state bug could become entangled with WAL/epoch state.
actions.problem: The architecture describes one database controller and a Container, but does not make the Container-backed Durable Object a separate authority domain.
actions.required_change: Split DatabaseControllerDO from DatabaseContainerDO; lifecycle reports are advisory.
actions.title: Database authority is implicitly coupled to Container lifecycle

actions.failure_mode: Validate–network-await–commit procedures can commit using stale authority state.
actions.problem: Single-threaded DO execution is not enough: arbitrary async awaits allow requests to interleave outside storage gates.
actions.required_change: Require prepare/I-O/finalise or transaction/outbox structure and test forced interleavings.
actions.title: Durable Object interleaving is underspecified

actions.failure_mode: Outbox, archival, checkpoint or lifecycle work may remain permanently stuck.
actions.problem: V15 treats alarms as background execution but does not account for at-least-once delivery with only a finite automatic retry sequence.
actions.required_change: Persist next_due/attempt state, catch/reschedule, and add an independent watchdog.
actions.title: Alarm progress can be stranded

actions.failure_mode: The pre-G13 no-delete invariant would depend only on application convention.
actions.problem: A broad object-read-write temporary credential includes DeleteObject/DeleteObjects in current R2 action semantics.
actions.required_change: Use explicit action lists, exact presigned operations, or gateway capabilities; separate parent tokens.
actions.title: R2 credential scopes are not delete-safe by construction

actions.failure_mode: A major independent guard against accidental overwrite/delete is left unused.
actions.problem: V15 states only that S3 Object Lock is absent and therefore misses the newer native Bucket Lock facility.
actions.required_change: Use coarse Bucket Locks as defense in depth, while documenting privileged-admin residual risk.
actions.title: R2 Bucket Locks are absent from the safety design

actions.failure_mode: A retry with changed bytes can corrupt an attempt while still looking like ordinary retry behavior.
actions.problem: R2 documents same-part replacement, including loss of the previous part if a replacement fails; multipart SHA-256 is composite.
actions.required_change: Bind each part number to one digest/length and allocate a new upload attempt for changed bytes; verify completed bytes by application SHA-256.
actions.title: Multipart object identity is incomplete

actions.failure_mode: A native TypeDB TCP/gRPC profile remains latent in V15 and can distort routing/session design.
actions.problem: Current Container architecture routes end-user requests through Workers and states non-HTTP TCP/UDP is unavailable through this path.
actions.required_change: Make V1 HTTP-only and move native transport to a future ADR.
actions.title: V1 transport scope is stale

actions.failure_mode: New Worker code may talk to old images during a correctness-critical format/protocol change.
actions.problem: Cloudflare activates Worker code before every instance is replaced; rollout completion is asynchronous and non-transactional.
actions.required_change: Add DeploymentCompatibilityEnvelope, reader-before-writer formats, observed convergence, and rollback image retention.
actions.title: Container rollouts are not modeled as mixed-version

actions.failure_mode: Deadlines, control latency and failure classification can be incorrect if calls are treated as local.
actions.problem: The platform does not guarantee a Container and its associated DO are colocated.
actions.required_change: Model them as ordinary network hops and test geographical/location separation.
actions.title: Container and lifecycle DO location is assumed too weakly

actions.failure_mode: Request inactivity is not equivalent to absence of open transaction/recovery/checkpoint work.
actions.problem: The Container helper defaults to inactivity shutdown; V15 does not make the policy controller-approved.
actions.required_change: Set explicit sleep policy and require controller-authorized hibernation.
actions.title: Default sleep and stop behavior can terminate an authoritative writer

actions.failure_mode: Release code can silently gain providers, test utilities, filters or alternate caches.
actions.problem: V15 discusses settings but does not prohibit default/all features. The pinned crate defaults to aws+foyer and exposes compaction_filters with a snapshot-consistency warning.
actions.required_change: Use default-features=false plus an explicit feature allowlist and linked-symbol/config attestation.
actions.title: SlateDB production features are not locked minimally

actions.failure_mode: Either preserving 1.93 forever or silently upgrading can be unsafe.
actions.problem: TypeDB pins Rust 1.93.0 while current stable has moved and may contain fixes.
actions.required_change: Run a parity lane and a qualified patched-stable lane; select one release compiler with full evidence.
actions.title: Compiler authority is single-lane and stale by design

actions.failure_mode: Local tests and deployed behavior can drift despite a lockfile.
actions.problem: V15 says the TS toolchain is pinned but does not bind Wrangler, workerd, Vitest pool, Miniflare and @cloudflare/containers tarballs to exact source commits.
actions.required_change: Add npm integrity, source commit and runtime/package relationship to G0.
actions.title: Cloudflare packages are versioned without source mapping

actions.failure_mode: A changed doc can retroactively change the meaning of a prior release.
actions.problem: V15 refers to current docs but does not lock the bytes, date, account profile and dependent probes as one artifact.
actions.required_change: Generate a PlatformContractRecord with content hash and real-account evidence.
actions.title: Platform documentation is not a reproducible input

actions.failure_mode: Large or parallel uploads can fail in a way that causes ambiguous object outcomes.
actions.problem: The design says streaming but does not make the 128 MB isolate and six simultaneous outgoing connections a formal capacity boundary.
actions.required_change: Add streaming negative controls, connection permits, body cancellation and direct bulk path qualification.
actions.title: Gateway limits are not composed with Workers limits

actions.failure_mode: Archival lag can hit SQLITE_FULL or overload before the system sheds safely.
actions.problem: V15 says bounded but does not derive admission thresholds from 10 GB/2 MB/soft QPS and workload amplification.
actions.required_change: Define high/emergency watermarks and reserved recovery/archival capacity.
actions.title: Controller limits are not conservative enough to be actionable

actions.failure_mode: Tests or fixtures can be selected by version while code comes from a different snapshot.
actions.problem: The selected commit is the real code identity; release/tag labels are secondary and can be adjacent but not identical.
actions.required_change: Lock the commit and separately record release/tag provenance.
actions.title: TypeDB source identity and release provenance are conflated

actions.failure_mode: A green runner can still be a false green.
actions.problem: The 59/8 count is useful reconnaissance, but leaf cases, macros, ignored cases and external behavior features are not yet generated.
actions.required_change: Treat all prose counts as non-authoritative until catalogue evidence exists.
actions.title: The upstream test denominator remains narrative

actions.failure_mode: Assembly tests can execute the wrong client/tool.
actions.problem: Versions appear in the source graph, but exact URLs, hashes, licences and package layout are not locked.
actions.required_change: Resolve and mirror the exact Linux fixtures at G0.
actions.title: Console/Loader fixture provenance is unresolved

actions.failure_mode: A same-key conflicting writer can still produce last-writer-wins behavior.
actions.problem: Strong read/list consistency does not identify bytes after an ambiguous write or replace application authentication.
actions.required_change: Retain exact conditions and application digest verification.
actions.title: R2 strong consistency can be overused as a proof shortcut

actions.failure_mode: Per-object locks or runtime-admin access would be unsafe and unscalable.
actions.problem: Bucket Locks allow finite rules and can be modified by privileged administration.
actions.required_change: Use coarse prefixes, separate lock administrator, continuous audit and policy-change events.
actions.title: Bucket Lock rule-count and policy administration are not modeled

actions.failure_mode: Old credentials may remain usable briefly after controller recovery.
actions.problem: R2 permission changes can propagate eventually.
actions.required_change: Use controller incarnation/epoch checks as immediate authority; measure revocation and test old credentials.
actions.title: IAM revocation is not an immediate fence

actions.failure_mode: Pinning only a repository SHA without package/runtime tests is insufficient.
actions.problem: Recent releases contain multiple lifecycle/start/stop race fixes.
actions.required_change: Map package to source and execute mutation/rollout/reset lifecycle tests.
actions.title: @cloudflare/containers is a fast-moving correctness dependency

actions.failure_mode: Developers may bypass the rule or the runner may hide ordinary crate failures.
actions.problem: V15 makes the conformance runner the only test entry point, which can hinder developer iteration and creates another single authority.
actions.required_change: Allow bare local tests as non-normative; release coverage remains catalogue-defined.
actions.title: Bare cargo-test prohibition is over-centralized

actions.failure_mode: CI pressure may motivate unsafe cache exceptions.
actions.problem: Hashing all vendored sources for every task causes huge invalidation and couples unrelated workspaces.
actions.required_change: Use per-workspace dependency digests and content-addressed offline stores.
actions.title: Global vendor directory in every cache key is inefficient and brittle

actions.failure_mode: Ad hoc sharding can hide missing cases or mixed configs.
actions.problem: Real-platform release execution may be too large for one invocation and profile.
actions.required_change: Bind shards to one catalogue/source/config and require complete signed reassembly.
actions.title: U4 full corpus needs a coherent sharding/reassembly contract

actions.failure_mode: Marketing/operations may overstate resilience.
actions.problem: Same-provider and privileged-account risks remain.
actions.required_change: Keep operational, account-isolated and independently immutable backup classes distinct.
actions.title: Bucket locks do not make an R2 backup an independent disaster copy

actions.failure_mode: A shared Worker/package/binding can accidentally expose cleanup paths.
actions.problem: Tests need cleanup, while production explicitly must not delete.
actions.required_change: Use separate buckets/accounts/principals and exclude cleanup code from the production bundle.
actions.title: Production and test delete capabilities can leak through shared config

actions.failure_mode: Reviewers can treat historical statements as live requirements.
actions.problem: V15 mixes old revision names and current normative language.
actions.required_change: Mark historical evidence explicitly and make main sections authoritative.
actions.title: Historical appendix labels and source counts are confusing

actions.failure_mode: Maintenance cost and tool bugs become project risks.
actions.problem: A specific task runner adds churn without improving correctness proof.
actions.required_change: Demote it to an optional ADR-controlled convenience.
actions.title: Optional orchestrator is over-prescriptive
